deadline_ms.description: Total time budget for ALNS orchestration. Optional, defaults to `time_limit_ms`.

enabled.description: Enable ALNS/LNS mode. Optional, defaults to true when `alns` object is provided.

iterations.description: Requested number of ALNS iterations. Optional, defaults to 24.

reaction_factor.description: Reaction factor for adaptive operator weights in range (0, 1]. Optional, defaults to 0.3.

segment_size.description: Adaptive weight update cadence (iterations per segment). Optional, defaults to 6.

temperature_end.description: End temperature for acceptance policy. Optional, defaults to 0.12.

temperature_start.description: Start temperature for acceptance policy. Optional, defaults to 1.0.

beam_depth.description: Search depth (number of expansion levels). Optional, defaults to 2.

beam_width.description: Beam width (how many states are kept per depth level). Optional, defaults to 2.

branch_factor.description: Branch factor (expansions per state). Optional, defaults to 2.

deadline_ms.description: Total time budget for beam orchestration. Optional, defaults to `time_limit_ms`.

enabled.description: Enable beam mode. Optional, defaults to true when `beam` object is provided.

candidates_invalid_fitness.description: Candidates discarded due to invalid fitness.

candidates_rejected_equal.description: Rejected because score was exactly equal to current best.

candidates_rejected_primary_objective.description: Rejected because primary objective was worse.

candidates_rejected_tie_bbox_area.description: Rejected by tie-break on bbox area.

candidates_rejected_tie_bbox_void.description: Rejected by tie-break on bbox internal void area.

candidates_rejected_tie_corner_free.description: Rejected by tie-break on corner free rectangle area (V9: waste consolidation).

candidates_rejected_tie_min_util.description: Rejected by tie-break on minimum per-sheet utilisation (unbalanced layout).

candidates_rejected_tie_perimeter.description: Rejected by tie-break on total perimeter.

candidates_valid.description: Candidates with valid fitness considered for ranking.

source.description: Selection source (currently top-K population scoring inside restart).

winner_corner_free_area_mm2.description:
Winner's total corner-anchored free rectangle area (mm^2). Higher =
waste consolidated into one reusable corner remnant (V9).

winner_max_edge_gap_mm.description: Winner's maximum edge gap across all sheets (mm). Telemetry only (V9).

winner_min_sheet_util_pct.description: Winner's minimum per-sheet utilisation (%). Higher = more balanced layout.

winner_sheet_util_spread_pct.description: Winner's per-sheet utilisation standard deviation (%). Telemetry only (V9).

enabled.description:
Enable sheet consolidation. Optional, defaults to true when the
`consolidate` object is provided.

max_passes.description:
Maximum number of full consolidation passes over the layout. Optional,
defaults to 8. Each pass that saves a sheet restarts the scan.

max_window.description:
Largest window of least-full sheets to pool and try to repack into one
fewer sheet. Optional, defaults to 3 (try 2->1 and 3->2). Clamped to 2..=6.

window_ga_ms.description:
Per-window GA budget (ms) used to repack a pooled window when the
instant multi-heuristic FFD cannot hit the target sheet count. Optional,
defaults to 0 (FFD only — no per-window GA).

windows_accepted.description: Number of windows that successfully consolidated.

CutQuality.description:
V62: high-level cut-quality tier for `engine=heuristic`. Expands into the
low-level `consolidate`/`lns` post-process flag sets (see
`Params::cut_quality`). Independent of `sla_profile`/`ga_profile`.

epochs.description: Number of GA epochs in range 1..=2000.

fill_penalty.description: V15/V17 largest-waste-component fill penalty. Optional, defaults to service env/default.

top_k_candidates.description: Top-K population candidates to evaluate by business scorer in range 1..=64.

zone_penalty.description: V15/V17 zones-aware GA fitness penalty. Optional, defaults to service env/default.

debug_artifacts.description:
Emit before/diff SVG artifacts for paired visual analysis. Optional,
defaults to false.

enabled.description:
Enable group-shift postprocess. Optional, defaults to true when
`group_shift` object is provided.

max_passes.description: Maximum accepted side-group shifts. Optional, defaults to 4.

min_shift_mm.description: Ignore moves smaller than this many millimeters. Optional, defaults to 5.0.

enabled.description:
Enable the LNS polish. Optional, defaults to true when the `lns` object
is provided.

max_iters.description:
Maximum destroy/repair iterations. Optional, defaults to 2000 (the
deadline usually binds first). Clamped to 1..=200000.

max_window.description:
Largest destroy window (number of sheets pooled per iteration). Optional,
defaults to 4. Clamped to 2..=8.

window_ga_ms.description:
Per-window GA budget (ms) used when FFD cannot repack a window into the
target; same semantics as `consolidate.window_ga_ms`. Optional, default 0.

unplaced_items.description: Items that did not fit on the requested number of sheets

include_svg.description: Include SVG artifact in response. Optional, defaults to true.

max_retry_attempts.description:
Maximum number of attempts (including the initial one) when
`retry_strategy = smart`.  Optional, defaults to 3.  Values below 1
are clamped to 1 (no retry).

enabled.description: Enable dense-first peeling. Optional, defaults to true when `partition` object is provided.

sheet_budget_ms.description:
Time budget per peeling iteration (ms). Optional, defaults to
`time_limit_ms / planned_sheet_count`.

applied.description:
Whether the partitioned (peeled) packing was actually used for the
final answer (false = fell back to the regular pipeline).

densest_zones.description:
V10: waste regions on the densest sheet for each peel iteration.
Empty when partition was not applied.

fallback_reason.description: Reason for falling back to the regular pipeline, if any.

group_area_pct.description: Utilisation (%) of each frozen sheet, peel order.

group_sizes.description: Number of parts frozen on each sheet, peel order (last = remainder).

candidate_count.description: Number of candidate strategies in portfolio. Optional, defaults to 4.

deadline_ms.description: Total time budget for portfolio orchestration. Optional, defaults to `time_limit_ms`.

enabled.description: Enable portfolio mode. Optional, defaults to true when `portfolio` object is provided.
Enable profile-pool mode. Optional, defaults to true when `profile_pool` object is provided.

fill_penalty.description: Fill penalty used for every profile. Optional, defaults to ga_override/default 0.1.

max_lead_drop_pp.description:
Maximum lead-utilisation drop allowed before a lower-zone candidate
is rejected, except breakthrough layouts with <=4 zones. Optional, defaults to 0.8.

rescue_accept_min_max_corner_mm2.description: Reject rescue candidates whose largest corner-free rectangle is below this area.

rescue_when_max_corner_below_mm2.description:
Trigger adaptive seed rescue when the provisional winner's largest
corner-free rectangle is below this area.

rescue_when_zones_gt.description:
Trigger adaptive seed rescue when the provisional winner has more than
this many waste regions. Optional, defaults to 5 when seed_offsets exist.

rescue_zone_penalties.description: Extra zone-penalty profiles evaluated only when profile-pool rescue is triggered.

seed_offsets.description:
Extra seed offsets to evaluate adaptively when the initial profile pool
still has too many waste regions or too small a reusable corner.

zone_penalties.description: Zone-penalty profiles to evaluate. Optional, defaults to [0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.5].

winner_visual_waste_regions.description: Waste regions without part inflation (`gap=0`), closer to visual review.

winner_waste_regions.description: Waste regions with kerf+spacing inflation, used by current selection.

RemnantTelemetry.description:
V72: honest visual-remnant telemetry. Measures how reusable the offcut is by
rasterizing the usable area of every used sheet on a coarse grid and
flood-filling the empty cells into connected regions. Unlike `bbox_void`
(free area inside the part group's bounding box) this counts *connectivity*:
a layout whose free space is one big rectangle scores far better than one
whose free space is split into staircase notches of the same total area.
Computed only when `include_svg` is true (same inspection intent; skipped on
the latency-sensitive `include_svg=false` path).

free_fragments.description:
Total number of connected empty regions across all used sheets. Lower is
better — fewer, larger offcuts.

grid_mm.description: Raster grid step in mm (square cells).

largest_free_frac.description:
`largest_free_mm2` as a fraction of total empty area (0..1). 1.0 means all
free space is one connected region; low values mean fragmented offcuts.

largest_free_mm2.description:
Area of the single largest connected empty region, in mm2 — the biggest
reusable remnant in the whole layout.

mean_sheet_largest_free_frac.description:
Mean over used sheets of each sheet's largest-free-region fraction. Focuses
on per-sheet remnant quality rather than the whole-layout aggregate.

attempts.description: Total number of optimization attempts actually executed (>= 1).

initial_failure.description:
Description of the failure mode detected on the first attempt, if
any.  Drives which strategy is picked for the first retry.

retries.description: Number of recovery attempts after the initial one (i.e. retries).

strategies.description:
Strategies used for each attempt beyond the first, in order.
Empty when no retry was needed.

qty.description: Quantity of this stock available. If omitted or 0, unlimited sheets will be used.

UnplacedItem.description: Item that could not be placed on the requested sheets

reason.description: Reason why item was not placed: "oversized" or "qty_limit"
